newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Danish shares seen up 4 pct end-March '98.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Danish shares seen up 4 pct end-March '98.

text.p: Leading Danish share prices are expected to rise by an average of only 3.6 percent by the end of 1998's first quarter next March, according to a Reuter consensus of analysts' forecasts issued on Tuesday.
Thirteen analysts saw the Copenhagen bourse's top-20 KFX index rising to between 140 and 175 at the end of March next year, an average of 158 -- compared to 152.07 at 1300 gmt on Tuesday.
They forecast an average of 152 by end-June 1997 rising slightly to 153 by end-September 1997.

Service, industry, transport and consumer goods sector paper were seen as poised for biggest gains, while banking and insurance in particular were expected by the panel to do worst in the 12-month period ahead due mainly to the prospect of U.S.-inspired, rising interest rates.
The KFX index has risen 11.7 percent so far in 1997.
